# Meet the inputs

Place prepared `summary-statistics.tsv` and `study-metadata.json` in `data/my-study/`. Follow the [field contract](../synthetic/02-meet-the-data.qmd).

Use `templates/study-metadata.json` as a starting point; it is deliberately incomplete. Replace all prompts from source documentation. Never guess the build or effect allele, invent INFO scores, convert odds ratios into quantitative beta, or copy synthetic N.

Keep source files, their checksums and a record of column mappings. Treat missing required measurements as a reason to extend the importer or choose a compatible analysis.
